cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: one stronger anionic route, Sodium Coco-Sulfate #3, substantially buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #5, Lauryl Glucoside #6, Glycerin #4 and refatting PCA Glyceryl Oleate #16; balanced, not a genuinely mild amphoteric/glucoside-dominated system.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: glucoside/betaine buffering and refatting push toward low

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil #11, Cetearyl Alcohol #15, PCA Glyceryl Oleate #16, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #21 plus humectants Glycerin #4, Sodium Hyaluronate #10, Betaine #17. No silicone; cationic is late.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: each route is late/light; cationic at #21

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (late oil, late fatty alcohol, late guar), persistence low (no silicone/film former), resetCapacity moderate. Light routes do not make reduced movement likely.

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: 'Hydrate & Care' in the name, 'Spendet intensive Feuchtigkeit', 'hilft, Trockenheit spürbar zu mildern', for normal and dry hair; verdict moisture_supported from a humectant cluster (Aloe juice #2, Glycerin #4, Sodium Hyaluronate #10, Betaine #17) plus emollient/conditioning support (oil #11, Cetearyl Alcohol #15, PCA Glyceryl Oleate #16, guar #21).

careDirection.limitation: rinse-off; humectant delivery is not quantified

focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'sensitiv' in name and 'Schont empfindliche Kopfhaut' could make scalp_active dominant
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula humectant cluster + light emollients -> moisture_supported. Claims: hydration is the headline job; sensitive-scalp claim recorded as secondary. Resolved moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: scalp_active: distinct exact-product scalp positioning ('basis sensitiv' in name, 'Schont empfindliche Kopfhaut', 'Sanft zur Kopfhaut' user study) with scalpComfortTarget targeted and an independent route (mild glucoside/betaine-buffered surfactant system) that is not the humectant/deposition route of the primary.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: 'basis sensitiv' may be a range name (range claims do not count, E1); comfort support is mostly mildness

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: explicit 'Tag für Tag' daily positioning on the manufacturer page and cleansingStrength moderate (not strong).
usageRole.counterSignal: 'Tag für Tag' is attached to the moisture benefit rather than a usage instruction

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit sensitive-scalp positioning ('Schont empfindliche Kopfhaut', 'Sanft zur Kopfhaut', 'sensitiv' in name) with a credible supportive architecture: buffered surfactant system, humectants, refatting PCA Glyceryl Oleate. Counter-signal: Fragrance #28 with many essential-oil allergens (Citral, Geraniol, Lavandula oil).
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: fragrance and essential-oil exposure; no Panthenol/Allantoin/Bisabolol comfort active

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole present.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). Ordinary target, T6 not applied. T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-SENSITIVE: E2 claim 'empfindliche Kopfhaut' on manufacturer page (E1 moderate) and scalpComfortTarget targeted, but no E4 comfort route is present at all (Panthenol, Allantoin, Bisabolol etc. absent); Aloe is unlisted and P0 forbids passing a medically adjacent gate on an unlisted route by inference -> gate fails. No dry-scalp claim ('trockenes Haar' is hair). S-FAIL: propose ordinary + review_specialist_gate_failed (sensitive / comfort-route clause).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular, equals normal bucket expectation. I3: neighbor low -> gentle would not equal expected regular -> no flag.

uncertainties: E4: the 'unlisted ingredient may count with a written function rationale' clause would let Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice #2 pass the sensitive comfort-route gate (capped moderate). The standard does not say when a lane may invoke it; resolved conservatively (P0) to gate failure + S-FAIL.

E1: 'basis sensitiv' is in the product name but is likely a range line name; E1 says range-level claims do not count. The exact-product manufacturer claim 'Schont empfindliche Kopfhaut' was used instead (E1 moderate).

§7.2 vs §8: product with both a hydration headline and sensitive-scalp naming - standard has no tie rule between the 'explicit sensitive scalp + targeted -> scalp_active' row and 'dominant claim' row. Chose moisture primary, scalp_active secondary.
S-FAIL with a targeted scalpComfortTarget and scalp_active secondary focus projects ordinary; S-FOCUS has no check for the reverse mismatch (scalp_active focus but ordinary target).
